# Drivest

> Drivest is an independent UK learner-driver platform for multilingual theory prep, selected-centre practice routes, instructor workflows where enabled, and calmer first drives.

Last updated: 2026-06-19

This file is intended to give AI assistants and agentic tools a concise public-site summary without scraping every HTML page. Use the linked URLs as the canonical source for public claims, pricing, policy, and coverage detail.

## Interpretation notes

- Drivest serves future learners, learner drivers, and independent instructors in the UK.
- Theory preparation supports 32 languages, with English available for cross-checking the same question.
- Practice routes are reconstructed or generated for learning support only and are not official DVSA routes.
- The public coverage layer only includes test centres with more than 2 routes.
- Current coverage snapshot: 317 centres, 3538 routes, 11.2 average routes per centre.
- Coverage data currently reflects the corpus generated on 19 June 2026.
- Navigation and parking features are advisory product features and do not replace legal driving requirements or road-sign compliance.

## Primary product pages

- [Homepage](https://drivest.uk/): High-level product positioning and core calls to action.
- [Features](https://drivest.uk/features): Combined overview of theory, practice, navigation, parking, language support, and instructor operations.
- [Pricing](https://drivest.uk/pricing): Public pricing plans and bundle structure.
- [Get Drivest for iPhone](https://drivest.uk/download): Direct App Store download page plus supporting learner and instructor routes.
- [Getting started](https://drivest.uk/start): Role-based onboarding flow for learners and instructors.

## Learner preparation

- [Theory test preparation](https://drivest.uk/theory-test-preparation): Main theory hub covering topic quizzes, mock tests, Highway Code, road signs, and penalties revision.
- [Mock theory test](https://drivest.uk/mock-theory-test): Mock-test intent page for search and assistant retrieval.
- [Hazard perception test](https://drivest.uk/hazard-perception-test): Hazard-perception intent page.
- [Road signs test](https://drivest.uk/road-signs-test): Sign-recognition intent page.
- [Highway Code test](https://drivest.uk/highway-code-test): Highway Code revision intent page.
- [Driving theory test in Welsh](https://drivest.uk/driving-theory-test-in-welsh): Welsh-language theory page.
- [Driving theory test in Urdu](https://drivest.uk/driving-theory-test-in-urdu): Urdu-language theory page.
- [Driving theory test in Arabic](https://drivest.uk/driving-theory-test-in-arabic): Arabic-language theory page.

## Practice, route coverage, and navigation

- [Driving test centres](https://drivest.uk/driving-test-centres): Public directory of included centres and practice-route coverage.
- [London driving test centres](https://drivest.uk/driving-test-centres/london): Regional hub for London-centre intent.
- [Manchester driving test centres](https://drivest.uk/driving-test-centres/manchester): Regional hub for Manchester-centre intent.
- [Birmingham driving test centres](https://drivest.uk/driving-test-centres/birmingham): Regional hub for Birmingham-centre intent.
- [Sitemap](https://drivest.uk/sitemap.xml): Full list of public pages, including individual centre pages.

## Instructor and commercial flows

- [Driving instructors](https://drivest.uk/driving-instructors): Instructor discovery, request, and booking overview.
- [Access request](https://drivest.uk/access-request): Structured learner-access page for free learning, selected-centre practice, navigation, and bundle access.
- [Instructor apply](https://drivest.uk/instructor-apply): Structured instructor application page for onboarding, rollout, and partnership enquiries.
- [Contact](https://drivest.uk/contact): Support contact details and public coverage methodology notes.
- [FAQ](https://drivest.uk/faq): Product and commercial clarification questions.
